top_signals.title: Oil Prices Continue to Fall as Democratic Sweep Shakes Energy Markets
top_signals.summary: Crude oil prices moved even lower, and energy company stocks followed after the results of the U.S. midterms, as markets brace for a potentially radical change in U.S. policies. At the time of writing, Brent crude was trading at $94.30 per barrel, after dropping by 9% on Wednesday, and West Texas Intermediate was trading at $87.35 per barrel, after shedding 8% on Wednesday, following the Democrats’ majority in both houses. The S&P Energy index was down by 4.77% as of the time of writing, to 976.18, on expectations of a shift in U.S. foreign…

top_signals.title: Ascendas Firstspace Said to Consider $500 Million India IPO
top_signals.summary: Ascendas Firstspace Development Management Pvt. is considering an initial public offering in India that could raise about $500 million, according to people familiar with the matter, as the logistics and industrial parks developer seeks to tap the country’s buoyant equity markets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Commerzbank Sees 45% Jump in Profit Ahead of UniCredit Deal
top_signals.summary: Commerzbank AG reported a better-than-expected 45% jump in profit, in one of the last quarterly results as an independent bank before UniCredit SpA takes control of the German rival.

top_signals.title: Top U.N. court to rule on Myanmar’s Rohingya genocide case
top_signals.summary: While the ICJ can't enforce its decisions, a ruling that Myanmar committed genocide would put more international pressure on leader Min Aung Hlaing.
